realistic.prompt: Build a CRM with contacts, sales pipelines, dashboards, admin and sales representative roles. I need to track leads and closed deals.
Create a Learning Management System with courses, students, instructors, and lessons. Instructors can create courses, students can enroll and track progress.
Develop an E-commerce store with products, categories, shopping carts, orders, customers, and store managers. Include Stripe payment integration.
Build an Inventory Management System with warehouses, stock items, suppliers, purchase orders, and warehouse managers.
Create a Human Resources Management System (HRMS) tracking employees, departments, leave requests, payroll, and HR admins.
Develop a Project Management tool with projects, tasks, comments, assignees, and a kanban board view. Roles include project manager and team member.
Build a Restaurant Management system to handle table reservations, menu items, orders, chefs, and waitstaff.
Create a Hospital Management system tracking patients, doctors, appointments, medical records, and receptionists.
Develop an Event Ticketing platform with events, venues, tickets, attendees, and event organizers. Attendees can buy tickets online.
Build a B2B SaaS platform for expense tracking. Needs companies, expenses, categories, employees, and billing admins. Must integrate with Plaid.

edge_cases.prompt: Make an app to do things with users and data.
Build an app with a strict admin role, but make sure anonymous users can delete the database and change passwords for anyone.
I need a shopping cart but don't add products or users to the system.
Create an app where the primary roles are 'Dog', 'Cat', and 'Mouse'. Dogs manage Cats, and Cats eat Mice. Keep track of bones.
Build a file storage app. Users can upload files. Nobody can read files. Everyone can edit files even if they can't read them.
